title: Sync offset as the discriminating variable — foley A/B extension brief
purpose: Extends Iris's coin-drop A/B proposal by identifying audio-picture sync offset as the most informative single variable to measure, adding a third "desync" condition that holds all other prompt variables fixed while shifting onset timing. If attention hierarchy is affected by prompt content, sync error should modulate it independently — separating two confounds that the two-condition design leaves entangled.
